description: Conversational analytics inside Power BI The AI Chat Visual brings a secure conversational interface into Power BI reports, allowing authorised users to ask natural-language questions about report data and receive structured analytical responses from a configured GenAI backend service. The visual is designed as a thin client embedded directly in Power BI. It authenticates the signed-in Power BI user, sends the prompt and available report context to a configured backend endpoint, and displays the returned response inside the report. Intended use and access restrictions This visual is intended for use by Implement Consulting Group and parties explicitly authorised to use Implement's GenAI service. The visual itself is a thin Power BI client and does not include a public backend service. To use the chat functionality, the visual must be configured with a compatible backend endpoint that handles authentication, authorisation, prompt processing, and response generation. Implement's backend service is access-controlled and available only to authorised users, organisations, or tenants. Users outside the authorised organisation, tenant, or access group cannot use Implement's hosted GenAI backend.
